plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: The paved path: where backend and frontend code belongs, which repository conventions no linter catches, how to audit dependencies, and how a team keeps a durable record of what it already tried.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: A read-only reviewer that judges a change against the layering and placement rules the paved path defines, and reports findings with file-and-line evidence. It never fixes anything.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: An agent that answers a research question with evidence — from inside the repository or from the web — and reports back without editing anything.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development as a chain of specialised agents: write the specification, plan against the real repository, build it phase by phase, verify every stated requirement, then document what shipped. Human-gated at every stage.
